app_subtitle: Inspect certificates and compose complete certificate chains everything runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
checker_desc: Paste or upload a certificate to decode its contents and check its validity.
composer_desc: Paste your server certificate together with any intermediate certificates. They will be ordered into a correct chain and missing intermediates will be fetched automatically when possible.
paste_placeholder:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
…paste one or more PEM certificates here…
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
error_no_cert: No valid certificate found. Paste PEM data (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----) or upload a PEM/DER file.
error_file_read: Could not read a certificate from {name}.
link_bad: Signature could NOT be verified against the certificate below
chain_complete_root: Chain is complete a self-signed root certificate was reached.
aia_failed: The missing certificate could not be downloaded from {url} the CA server was unreachable on every route. Download it yourself and paste it above.
aia_relay_note: CA servers do not allow direct browser downloads, so issuer certificates are fetched through a relay. Only the CA's public certificate URL is sent — your own certificate never leaves the browser.
extras_note: {count} provided certificate(s) were not part of the chain and were ignored.
root_note: Root certificates are usually already present in client trust stores, so servers normally send the chain without the root.
chain_order: Certificate order: server certificate first, then intermediates, root last.
